assets.prompt: Production game animation asset, illustration-story. Create ONE transparent sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, 8 evenly spaced full body poses of the SAME female chef from the reference images, identity-preserving. Japanese anime cel animation style with crisp visible fine pixel edges and restrained pixel shading, stylish cute anime proportions about 4.5 heads tall (not tiny chibi), NOT 3D. Preserve short wild flame red and golden yellow hair, golden eyes, tilted cream chef hat, white blouse, red tie, cream flame-trim apron, black skirt, brown boots, black iron frying pan carried on her BACK and brown belt pouch. EVERY pose facing screen RIGHT in a three-quarter side view. Same body proportions and size across all cells, full head and boots within each cell with clear transparent gutters. Soft morning key light upper left. Poses in reading order: 1 standing calm holding CLOSED folded parchment map at waist in both hands; 2 lifting closed map to below chest; 3 both hands spreading the same map half unfolded; 4 holding fully unfolded map chest-level, eager expression; 5 walking step left leg ahead, hands still holding unfolded map and pan still on back; 6 walking step right leg ahead, same carried map; 7 hunger reaction, right hand has released map and rests at stomach, left hand keeps holding open map with right side gently drooping, head slightly lowered; 8 same left-hand map and right-hand stomach, head raised again, composed brave expression. Map cream paper blank with tiny faint terrain strokes only, NO TEXT. Do not add a second map, loose pan, accessories or other characters. Transparent background, no grid, no labels. This is an actual replacement pose atlas for a 30-second cinematic; prioritize anatomy, clear hands gripping map, consistent silhouette.

Production transparent animation sprite sheet for a Japanese anime inspired pixel-art game cinematic. Identity reference is Aling in the supplied image: deep blue hair, purple eyes, golden crescent and feather ornaments, long blue braid on viewer right in front view, violet cloak gold trim, white ruffle blouse, purple skirt, black boots, black raven with golden key on viewer left shoulder. Preserve identity and accessory side continuity; do not mirror. 6 full-body poses arranged exactly 3 columns x 2 rows evenly, each with transparent margin, all same proportions 4.5 heads tall, anime cel shading with fine crisp pixel edges, not 3D. Everyone is the SAME girl turned three-quarter towards screen LEFT. A single brown gold ledger belongs to her. Reading order: 1 dignified stands looking left, ledger closed at belt, arms relaxed; 2 lifts the SAME closed ledger off belt holding with both hands at lower chest (belt book is now absent); 3 opens book halfway with both hands (NO second book at belt); 4 holds fully open book and looks down at its pages; 5 fully open book in hands, raises eyes to look at traveller screen left; 6 same book-reading pose as 4, slightly different page position for turning page. Raven remains perched, long braid and cape are whole, no lost ornaments. Warm morning light top left. Full bodies from head to boots, same height/scale, no base/box/shadow/background, no labels and NO TEXT. Polished actual game artwork, clear anatomical hand-book contact, coherent one-book continuity.
assets.correction_prompt: Edit this 3 by 2 transparent six-pose Aling animation sheet. ONLY correct the gaze/body orientation: in ALL SIX poses she must face toward SCREEN LEFT, toward a traveller standing to the LEFT of her. Currently she is looking right; redraw, DO NOT horizontally mirror the image, since the raven, crescent feather, long braid and key are asymmetrical. Keep her identity, costume, all six pose meanings, exact evenly spaced cell layout, body scale, real transparent alpha and warm anime/pixel style. The blue braid should remain on her anatomical same side; the black raven remains on her same shoulder, not swapped. Pose 1 has one closed book at belt, poses 2–6 have that same book lifted in hands and NO book on belt. Left-looking three quarter face, eyes directed left or down to book; never facing screen right. Full boots and hair inside each cell, no clipping, no background.

assets.prompt: Create a cinematic background plate for a cozy Chinese coastal port town arrival scene, widescreen 16:10. Japanese animated film background art with clean cel-like shapes and visible subtle pixel-art texture/edges, warm sun upper left, azure ocean, inviting lived-in Chinese port, not European. Fixed side-on street-stage composition, NOT isometric and no extreme 3D perspective. Foreground lower 40% is broad empty gray stone-slab promenade suitable for two fullbody animated characters; their standing plane about 82% down image. Left midground: clearly identifiable quiet seaside bus stop shelter and road arriving from the LEFT which exits left, no bus painted in. Midground upper left/center: OPEN SEA with horizon, several small merchant sailing vessels, stone quays, ropes, low harbor wall and mooring bollards, sea visible beyond not a narrow river. Right background: welcoming Chinese town entrance with white plaster houses, layered blue-gray tiled roofs, muted red wood and teal shop awnings; path leads to town right. Enough clear staging space at center left and center right, no big central objects blocking bodies. One plain waist-high wooden crate in lower right at x78%, y84%, supporting an actress later (no character yet). No people, no birds, no characters, no text, no logo, no white crossing line painted (these will be separate game elements). Gorgeous coherent restrained palette, soft atmosphere, detailed architecture yet readable silhouettes, all props aligned to SAME ground plane. NOT a collage, NOT UI.
